summary: Enhance your sales skills with our Data Management and Analytics course. Learn to leverage data for effective training and improved sales performance.
lede: Data management and analytics for sales helps you turn inconsistent CRM records into reliable insight for pipeline and forecast decisions. You will learn to profile data, control master records, measure quality, enforce stage discipline, and connect sales measures to management reporting. Through practical exercises, you will classify CRM defects, define ownership with a RACI matrix, build a KPI dictionary, and map an analytics workflow from extraction to decision. You will also apply CRISP-DM to a sales conversion problem, use SQL concepts and dashboard logic for reporting, and review AI-assisted forecasting and lead scoring with attention to data readiness, human review, bias risks, and governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who create, govern, interpret, or act on sales data analytics in daily commercial operations. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who work with CRM records, sales reports, pipeline reviews, or revenue performance decisions.
audience: Account Managers using customer and opportunity data
modules: Pipeline Analytics with SQL and Power BI
Sales Analytics Strategy and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and access to a spreadsheet application. No coding or software installation is required for completion. The course uses provided sample CRM datasets and guided templates. Power BI or Tableau may support demonstrations, but equivalent dashboard software can be used where available. Advanced predictive modelling remains at conceptual awareness level.
